record.question: In which one of the following places is the Shompen tribe found?
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
The Shompen are an Indigenous people of Great Nicobar Island. The Ministry of Tribal Affairs report describes Great Nicobar as their home; Great Nicobar belongs to the Nicobar Islands, so “Nicobar Islands” is the correct broader location among the options. The source supports that geographic identification without treating the group as distributed across all of the archipelago.

Reference: https://tribal.nic.in/downloads/Statistics/OtherReport/BhuriaReportFinal.pdf
